claims.text: IPU states that the Democratic Party of the Friendly Islands (DPFI), led by the veteran pro-democracy MP 'Akilisi Pohiva, took eight of the 17 directly elected seats at the 27 November 2014 election, and that two of the independents who won seats joined the DPFI after the elections. It calls Pohiva the DPFI leader during the election campaign, and its summary fields give two parties contesting and one winning seats.
claims.locator: 'Purpose of elections', paragraphs 1-2; summary fields 'Number of parties contesting the election' and 'Number of parties winning seats'
claims.uncertainty: IPU-only: an interparliamentary summary citing Legislative Assembly communications, not a Legislative Assembly, registry or court record. A leader attestation at the election, not a leadership start or term. The two independents' joining dates are not given. IPU's 2014 party counts differ in approach from its 2017, 2021 and 2025 pages, which say candidates formally stood as independents; the eight-seat figure is IPU's statement and is not used as a party seat total.

claims.text: IPU states that on 29 December 2014 the new Legislative Assembly elected DPFI leader Pohiva as the new Prime Minister; its summary gives 29 December 2014 as the date of the new parliament's first session.
claims.locator: 'Purpose of elections', paragraph 3; 'Date of the first session of the new parliament'
claims.uncertainty: The Assembly's selection, not the royal appointment. No appointment instrument or effective date is in this source, and no to_pm holder is created from it.

claims.text: IPU states that the endorsement of King Tupou VI was received 'the following day' after the 29 December 2014 Assembly selection, in the sentence reporting that the new Cabinet took office on 19 January 2015.
claims.uncertainty: No structured date is recorded: the day is given only relatively, and 30 December 2014 would be derived from that wording. The sentence joins the endorsement to the Cabinet's taking office, so whether the endorsement was of Pohiva's premiership or of the Cabinet is not explicit. No royal instrument was seen; this is not an appointment date.

claims.text: IPU states that the new 12-member Cabinet, comprising five DPFI members, one noble and six independent members, took office on 19 January 2015, and lists the Democratic Party of the Friendly Islands (DPFI) as the one party in government.
claims.locator: 'Purpose of elections', paragraph 3; 'Number of parties in government'; 'Names of parties in government'
claims.uncertainty: A Cabinet taking office, separate from the Assembly selection and the endorsement. No minister is named and no to_ministers or to_pm holder is created.
